mapper.select: select * from wallet_account where login_name = #{loginName} and status = 1 limit 1
select * from wallet_account where login_name = #{loginName} limit 1
select * from wallet_account where phone = #{phone} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into wallet_account (wallet_user_no, login_name, wallet_name, phone, pay_password, balance, status, last_login_time, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{walletUserNo}, #{loginName}, #{walletName}, #{phone}, #{payPassword}, #{balance}, #{status}, #{lastLoginTime}, now(), now(), #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
